parsed.justification: The athlete in the black and white shorts rolls over his opponent's shoulder to secure seatbelt control and insert hooks, successfully establishing back control.
The athlete in the black rashguard transitions from a front headlock to climb onto his opponent's back, securing his hooks to establish back control.
The top player attempts to secure back control from the turtle position but is unable to insert his second hook due to the bottom player's tight defense.
The top player inserts both legs as hooks around the turtled bottom player's thighs to secure back control.
